patch.value: Ollama semantic indexing collapses to one item per request because the batch character ceiling equals the per-item corpus ceiling

The explicit qwen3-embedding full rebuild for this 2,592-item project honored search.embedding_batch_size=32 syntactically but produced 2,504 provider batches. The Ollama request character ceiling is the same 3,200 characters allowed for one corpus item, so almost every full-size item forces its own network request. This makes the documented batch setting ineffective for ordinary rich PM items and cannot approach the 100k to 1M scale contract.

Separate per-input corpus truncation from provider request byte and token budgets; negotiate or configure safe multi-input request limits per provider and model; preserve deterministic input to vector ordering under parallelism adaptive split retry and resume; expose effective batch count size distribution throughput ETA provider model and limit sources in the receipt; add timeout payload-too-large partial-failure and restart negative controls; benchmark qwen3 Ollama at current 2.5k plus synthetic 100k and 1M tiers with declared throughput and memory ceilings; keep mutation refresh bounded and prevent a full rebuild from starving ordinary reads and writes; public SDK owns batching scheduling receipts and recovery while CLI only renders them
pm 2026.8.28 with Ollama 0.32.1, qwen3-embedding:0.6b, LanceDB, embedding_batch_size 32, and 2,592 rich tracker items

Configure project semantic search for local Ollama qwen3-embedding:0.6b and LanceDB, then run pm reindex --mode semantic --full --progress --json. Observe 2,504 batches for 2,592 inputs and mostly batch size one.

The provider uses efficient bounded multi-input requests up to an evidence-based byte or token budget, reports effective batching and throughput, and scales through resumable parallel or incremental work without sacrificing deterministic vector order.
The 3,200-character per-request ceiling equals the 3,200-character per-item limit, reducing nearly every batch to one input despite configured batch size 32.
